mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.title, m.unit, JSON_ARRAYAGG( JSON_OBJECT( 'value', d.value, 'name', d.name, 'unit', m.unit, 'itemStyle', JSON_OBJECT( 'colors', JSON_ARRAY(d.color_one, d.color_two) ) ) ) AS datas FROM `screen_left_one_main` m JOIN `screen_left_one_data` d ON m.id= d.group_id GROUP BY m.id, m.title,m.unit ORDER BY m.sort ASC;
